name: Default
shortDescription: QDirStat disk usage analyzer streamed to the browser, with a tree map of files and folders and a viewer for cache files collected on headless servers.

alerts.message: Sign in with the WEB_AUTHENTICATION_USERNAME and generated WEB_AUTHENTICATION_PASSWORD values from the environment. QDirStat only sees files inside the container: upload files or a qdirstat-cache-writer cache file to /storage with the file manager (folder icon in the web control panel), then rescan or use File > Read Cache File.
